sentences.text: I cannot confirm that pre-payment charges may be levied on this loan from the evidence provided, because the in-force UCB directions cite floating-rate loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 in para 260 and loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026 in para 261, and this case is sanctioned on December 31, 2025. [E13, E14]

The in-force evidence does say a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals under para 261(1), but that para is stated to apply to loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026. [E14]

The in-force evidence also says para 260 covers existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 for purposes other than business to individual borrowers, so the stated cutoff does not match a loan sanctioned on December 31, 2025. [E13]
The older floating-rate foreclosure-charge directions are marked superseded, so they do not provide an in-force basis for this answer. [E2, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8, E9, E10, E11, E12]

missing.slot: applicable pre-payment-charge rule for a floating-rate home loan sanctioned on 2025-12-31
missing.searched: Searched the in-force UCB directions on pre-payment charges for floating-rate loans, including paras 260 and 261, and the older floating-rate foreclosure-charge directions; no in-force source was found that squarely covers a sanction date of 2025-12-31.
